_readme: Hand-kept entries. Every text field is {en, zh}. Names and codes stay English in both. supplierNotes is keyed by the supplier name in odm.json.

summary.en: The regional hub. Parts wait here until a picklist sends them to an NS.
summary.zh: 區域發貨中心。零件先放在這裡，等 picklist 再出貨給各 NS。

role.en: Receives what the ODMs ship for all NS together, holds it, and sends each NS its share by picklist.
role.zh: 接收 ODM 為所有 NS 一起出的貨，暫存後再依 picklist 分送給各 NS。

value.en: The RO orders the total for all NS; the ODM ships to the hub, which splits it by NS.
value.zh: RO 彙總所有 NS 的需求一起下單；ODM 出貨到 hub，再由 hub 分給各 NS。

value.en: Feili Inventory = open picklists + Stock in HUB. NS + Feili = AAP.
value.zh: Feili Inventory = 未出的 picklist + Stock in HUB；NS + Feili = AAP。

value.en: Held at the cost it came in at; it does not move with exchange rates.
value.zh: 以入庫成本計算，不隨匯率變動。

value.en: PLS_Picklist_Monthly and PLS_Stock_Monthly on the 1st: open picklists and stock in the hub.
value.zh: 每月 1 日的 PLS_Picklist_Monthly 和 PLS_Stock_Monthly：hub 的未出 picklist 與庫存。

summary.en: Acer Group affiliate. From 1 Dec 2026 the parts PAP buys reach the NS through HSN Group; PAP still does the purchasing.
summary.zh: Acer 集團關係企業。2026/12/1 起，PAP 買的零件改經 HSN Group 送到各 NS；採購仍由 PAP 負責。

role.en: Delivers the parts PAP buys to the NS, from 1 Dec 2026.
role.zh: 自 2026/12/1 起，負責把 PAP 買的零件送到各 NS。

value.en: Check how the PO entities change.
value.zh: 先確認 PO 的開立主體如何改變。

summary.zh: 澳洲的服務公司。紐西蘭的 ACNZ 隸屬於 ACA。

notes.en: 2026-11-18: For AAP's extra (Non-FCST) demand of 40 × 27.J1HNG.001 (POWER CORD 1M EU), BMORN confirmed 40 pcs but asked for the PO against 27.DLQNG.001 at USD 2 (system price of J1HNG: USD 1). No substitute chain links the two in the Critical Report.
notes.zh: 2026-11-18：AAP 額外需求（Non-FCST）27.J1HNG.001（POWER CORD 1M EU）40 個，BMORN 確認可供 40 個，但要求 PO 改下 27.DLQNG.001、單價 USD 2（J1HNG 系統價 USD 1）。Critical Report 中兩者沒有替代料關係。

notes.en: LTB shipments follow a 9-month schedule (others: 12 months), partial per RO.
notes.zh: LTB 出貨採 9 個月排程（其他 ODM 為 12 個月），依 RO 分批。
